finding.statement: Fresh-rebuild determinism requires excluding both volatile evaluated_at and envelope-only delta_id from training-bearing measured_packet and stable execution replay identity. Otherwise equivalent measured executions can be re-keyed by observation/evaluation envelope metadata and produce different packet bytes or duplicate causal identities.
finding.counterhypothesis: delta_id is a stable measured-execution identity and should remain in packet/replay identity.
finding.counterhypothesis_disposition: REJECTED_FOR_CURRENT_CONTRACT: current semantics treat delta_id as candidate/evaluation-envelope identity; source/provenance, target bytes, execution admission, metric and measured outcomes already bind the evidence-bearing execution.

semantics: evaluated_at excluded from training-bearing packet bytes and retained metadata-only
delta_id excluded from measured packet and stable execution replay identity
measured evidence identity directly wraps the same replay-stable packet preimage
timestamp/narration/delta-id envelope-only replay must remain duplicate/token-stable
same stable execution identity with changed measured evidence remains fail-closed conflict
